{{Top|leg}}
The '''Gran colonization program''' was a program commissioned by the [[Neo-Tayan]]s, leaders of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] established colonies on a number of worlds, including [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] and [[Silunes]]. Ultimately, the residents of Kinyen separated themselves from their colonies, who were led new government known as the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
